title: Dynamical BEC formation and vanishing entropy for trapped bosons in non-relativistic QED via nonlinear resonance cascades
abstract: The dynamical formation of a complete Bose-Einstein condensate and the asymptotic purification of trapped bosons coupled to a quantized radiation field are rigorously established. By tracking the macroscopic one-particle density matrix $κ_T$ through a nonlinear resonance cascade, it is demonstrated that radiative relaxation irreversibly depletes all excited trap modes, even when the initial macroscopic state $κ_0$ is genuinely mixed. Here $κ_T$ is an average, with respect to a de Finetti measure $μ_0$, over mean-field particle-field orbits, so that the mixedness of $κ_0$ reflects a statistical ensemble of orbits. Under the assumptions of a non-vanishing initial ground state component and strictly positive downward Fermi-Golden-Rule rates, strong trace-norm convergence to a pure condensate is proven, $$   \lim_{T\to\infty} \| κ_T-|χ_0\rangle\langleχ_0| \|_{\mathfrak{S}_1(\mathfrak{h})} = 0 \, . $$ Furthermore, the von Neumann entropy of the macroscopic one-particle density matrix is shown to vanish asymptotically, $$   \lim_{T\to\infty}S[κ_T]=0 \, , $$ without any claim of monotonicity in $T$. Thus, any initially mixed, positive-entropy state ($0<S[κ_0]<\infty$) is purified to the ground state $|χ_0\rangle\langleχ_0|$. For the proof, we derive the Hartree hierarchy of the coupled system of bosons and photons from the finite-$N$ BBGKY hierarchy of the microscopic quantum many-body system, establishing trace-norm convergence in the mean-field limit as $N\to\infty$. The limits are taken successively; first $N\to\infty$, then the weak-coupling limit, and finally $T\to\infty$. Although the global particle-field evolution remains unitary, the macroscopic one-particle state converges to a pure state as energy and correlations are continuously radiated into the dispersive field.
summary: This theoretical paper proves that trapped bosons coupled to a quantized radiation field undergo irreversible dynamical purification, regardless of their initial mixed state. By tracking the one-particle density matrix, the authors show that the system's entropy vanishes asymptotically, forcing the state into a pure condensate ground state. This establishes a rigorous mechanism for condensation driven by radiative relaxation in a quantum many-body setting.
main_problem: The paper rigorously establishes the dynamical formation of a complete Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) and the asymptotic purification of trapped bosons coupled to a quantized radiation field.
main_result: It proves that any initially mixed, positive-entropy state purifies to the ground state, and the von Neumann entropy of the macroscopic one-particle density matrix vanishes asymptotically.
method: The analysis involves deriving the Hartree hierarchy from the BBGKY hierarchy and tracking the one-particle density matrix through a nonlinear resonance cascade while taking successive limits ($N 	o \infty$, weak-coupling, $T 	o \infty$).
